utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Friday the 23rd, and apparently the rain's staying for the entire weekend. Anyone got plans that aren't getting soaked?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Standing beside a football pitch, so no. Waterproofs and regret, mainly.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office, anyway. Bit more cheerful than the weather.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That explains why nobody's got their camera on. You're all eating.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Mine's off for entirely professional reasons. Right, what's already finished before we get into the live stuff?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, so I tested the line 1 hydraulics yesterday and it's all fine now. That's finished.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That was the one with the pressure wobble, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that one. Test was fine, nothing outstanding from it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the Waste Heat Boiler yesterday. Done.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Ah, good. I was looking at the old entry, then.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Probably. Definitely yesterday, not something still waiting for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I noticed the line two was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Settled back to normal, or just stopped climbing?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Back to normal. Just an observation, not raising another job off it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Actual jobs, then. The parts collection is the big production one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you go to Northfield to pick up the replacement parts for the air compressor by end of day? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't leave site for that. I'm the maintenance cover here, so I can't take the collection.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Fiona Doyle, can you take that instead? Go to Northfield to pick up the replacement parts for the air compressor by end of day. Same priority: that's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I can take it. I'll go to Northfield and pick up the replacement parts for the air compressor by end of day. Collection first for me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out there. That's the air compressor parts, not anything for the boiler?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Air compressor, yeah. That's the collection I've agreed to.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, separately, can you grease and check the bearings on the line 3 barrel by the 28th? No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the line 3 barrel by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just the grease and bearing check, rather than a strip-down?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Grease and check, no rush, by the 28th. Not asking for a strip-down.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace, can you sort the training records for the new starters?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, I'll sort the training records for the new starters.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just to separate it out, we're talking the records, not me delivering another round of training?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The records, yes. No additional training session in this request.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine, happy with that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, I'll inspect the main water valve for leaks as well. It's not an emergency but don't let it slip, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Han. The main water valve leak inspection is yours, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it. Not an emergency, but I won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Are we talking an inspection only, at this point?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Inspection for leaks, yeah. I'm not agreeing a valve replacement here.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: While we're on parts, the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the trucks. That's still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, noted as blocked. Not putting a new job against anyone for that in this meeting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Also, we were going to replace the belt on the palletizer, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, so that belt's not in today's work at all?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Correct. Deferred to next month, not a job for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, can you order spare parts for the forklifts by tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I can't take that as well, sorry. With the Northfield collection first, I haven't got the capacity for the ordering too.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Hannah, can you take over ordering spare parts for the forklifts, by tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yes, I'll order spare parts for the forklifts by tomorrow morning. I'll take that over.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just checking we all mean Saturday. Friday brain's already setting in here.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, tomorrow morning, Saturday. That's what I've accepted.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Han, can you also sort the permit to work and isolation for the AC1 on the 3rd? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: On the 3rd, yeah? Not bring the isolation forward and have it done before then?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the 3rd, yes. That's the date. That's holding production up so it needs doing first on that day's work.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Understood. I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the AC1 on the 3rd, first priority.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—both the permit and the isolation are in that, aren't they?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Both, yes. Permit to work and isolation for the AC1. I've got the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fiona, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the outfeed conveyor by Thursday? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the outfeed conveyor by Thursday. Understood it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's the coming Thursday, just so we're not reading yesterday off an old sheet?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, the coming Thursday. By Thursday, and it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine. Both clearing the jam and checking the sensors are with me.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And urgent doesn't mean hands through a guard. Usual safe access rules still apply.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Absolutely. No reaching past guards, no shortcuts.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, quick read-back. I want the production priorities clear without turning everything else into a panic.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Northfield for the replacement parts for the air compressor first, by end of day. And the outfeed conveyor jam and sensors are urgent, by Thursday. I've got those two.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I've got the main water valve inspection, the forklifts spare parts order by tomorrow morning, and the AC1 permit to work and isolation on the 3rd. That last one first on the day, as agreed.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Line 3—sorry, the line 3 barrel bearings, grease and check by the 28th. No rush. Not the parts collection.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And the training records for the new starters are mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Hydraulics and the Waste Heat Boiler filter are finished. Warm running settled, trucks delivery still blocked, palletizer belt deferred. None of those is an extra job for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, that's the distinction. Otherwise that old list makes it look like we've agreed about twenty things.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Twenty things and a cake. Only one of those ever disappears without a meeting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: It's disappearing quite effectively during this one, actually.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before there's only icing left—thanks, everyone. That's us.
